firstPlayerRule: The hairiest player becomes the first Mission Leader and starts the first mission.
clarifications: The Mission Leader chooses mission intensity and receives cards first. Actions then begin with that player and continue clockwise.
After the Morale Drop, the Mission Leader token moves to the next player.

internalEvidence: Rendered PDF page 3 gives the hairiest-player criterion. Pages 4 and 6 show the Mission Leader preparing and acting first; page 9 gives the handoff. The English booklet is also listed at CMON’s official rulebook URL. Grizzled cards, Support tiles and the Mission Leader token match inventory BGG 171668.
